semiconductor_relevance: High — AMIDA Technology, Inc. specializes in semiconductor test instruments and systems, particularly for power ICs and mixed signal ICs.
summary: AMIDA Technology, Inc. develops and manufactures advanced testing systems for semiconductor components, including Power ICs, Mixed Signal ICs, and high-power devices like MOSFETs and IGBTs. Their solutions also encompass high-throughput testing for CMOS image sensor modules and specialized measurement systems for automotive and energy sectors.
capabilities: CMOS image sensor module test solutions
